name: Las Pedrosas (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow fly part with a dancetty edge bearing a red stripe, charged at the hoist with yellow ears of wheat on stones.
history: Municipal flag of Las Pedrosas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: dancetty white line between the blue and the yellow
fly part with a dancetty edge
horizontal stripe across the yellow fly
ears of wheat rising from stones
